summary:
ROUTED TO HUMAN — the durable fix touches protected surfaces (the DBOS/routines scheduler and the self-improvement loop's own watchdog code).

ROOT CAUSE (verified live): the dbos-executor-reaper (packages/operator-core/lib/dbos/dbos-executor-reaper.ts) stamps harness_shared.routines.metadata.last_error = "DBOS routineFire produced no DBOS operation output; executor reaper cancelled the stuck fire and requeued the routine" with last_error_source='dbos-executor-reaper' as a SELF-HEAL breadcrumb ("I recovered this routine"), NOT a genuine failure. collectRoutineFailureSignals (packages/operator-core/lib/harness/improvements/watchdog.ts ~L1049) fires on ANY non-empty metadata.last_error regardless of source, so it files a phantom "Background routine X is failing" bug. clearStaleReaperLastError only clears the marker on the routine's NEXT successful fire, so low-cadence routines (weekly/monthly batteries) carry it for weeks and re-file phantoms.

LIVE EVIDENCE: all 7 active routines currently carrying last_error have source=dbos-executor-reaper (0 genuine runner/git-sync errors); 40+ 'routine is failing' EIs exist (EI-6061/6083/6081/6242/5995/... loop-su-*, bp-singleton-*, hive-eval-battery, coord-invariant-monitor). EI-6061's own routine (improvement-watchdog) already self-healed (last_error is now NULL) — the instance is transient but the CLASS recurs.

PROPOSED DURABLE FIX (needs human review — protected surface): make the routine-failure collector ignore the reaper's self-heal marker. Either (A) in collectRoutineFailureSignals, exclude rows where metadata->>'last_error_source' = 'dbos-executor-reaper' UNLESS metadata->>'reaped_count' exceeds a genuine-wedge threshold (e.g. >=3 consecutive reaps = never self-heals); or (B) in the reaper, record the self-heal breadcrumb under a NON-last_error key (e.g. metadata.last_reap) and only promote to last_error after N consecutive reaps. (A) is smaller and keeps the git-sync-stall-watchdog signal intact. A regression test would assert routineFailureSignalsFromRows drops a single-reap reaper marker and still fires on a runner-sourced error and on a high reaped_count. STOP rationale: both fix sites are protected (DBOS scheduler / self-improvement loop own code) and a wrong change would silence real routine wedges.
